input.title: Full Stack Developer (Python + React)
input.description:
Hi




Our client is looking for a Full Stack Developer (Python + React) project in Remote below is the detailed requirement.




Job positing Title: Full Stack Developer (Python + React)

Location: Remote




Required Skills: Python, React JS, SQL Database, REST API




Job description:

 * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field
 * Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable web applications using Python and React JS.
 * Develop backend services, business logic, and RESTful APIs.
 * Build responsive and user-friendly frontend interfaces using React JS.
 * Design, develop, and optimize SQL database schemas, queries, and data models.
 * Integrate frontend components with backend APIs and database services.
 * Troubleshoot application issues and improve performance, scalability, and security.
 * Collaborate with cross-functional teams throughout the software development lifecycle.
 * Follow coding standards, conduct code reviews, and maintain technical documentation.
